topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I came home from work, expecting everything to be just as I left it, but my driveway was empty. The spot where my car should have been was now just a patch of cold, empty asphalt. My hands tremble as I scan the area, hoping for some sign that this is all a misunderstanding. The 'No Parking' signs along the street seem to mock me, even though my car has never been parked there. I check my mailbox, hoping for some sort of note or explanation, but it's as empty as my driveway. Thoughts race through my mind, each one more unsettling than the last. What do I do now? Who could have done this? The world feels a little less stable, a little less safe.
